description: Stream CrowdSec LAPI decisions (new and deleted) and forward them to Sekoia intake
name: CrowdSec Decision Trigger

scopes.description: Comma-separated list of decision scopes to filter (e.g. ip,range)

origins.description: Comma-separated list of decision origins to filter

scenarios_containing.description: Only return decisions whose scenario name contains this string

scenarios_not_containing.description: Exclude decisions whose scenario name contains this string
